parsed.explanation: The dossier documents state-directed hostility toward gender-nonconforming people: an official advisory barring trans people from busy public areas, security-force harassment/detention of suspected trans individuals, summary trials, forced anal tests, and documented custodial rape of a trans detainee — state-tolerated targeting (tier 2) with no discrimination protection, no hate-crime recourse, and forcible conformity pressure (surgery-or-penalty). Sodomy statutes operate directly as a lever: trans women are officially conflated with gay men, so the flogging/death-penalty backdrop attaches to outed trans visitors. Executions and mass raids are documented, though partly dated and without denominators. The state-funded surgery regime is resident-facing and coercive, not a visitor protection. Borders/facilities are undocumented, but structural signals — criminalisation, enforced morality policing, no record of relief — dominate.
